item.title: Verbose beta 293
item.description:
Pastes that land, and motion that settles

Mac

  • When Accessibility looks on but Verbose can't paste, Fix sets it up again in one step. This happens when the switch in System Settings belongs to an earlier copy of Verbose. Fix removes that entry and adds this copy back, so you switch it on once.
  • A dictation that can't paste is copied as usual, so ⌘V and clipboard managers have it.
  • The chosen option in a switch slides to your pick with a slight bounce. By day and All thoughts, Literal, Clean, and Polished, a transcript's tabs, and every other switch like them.
  • Pages, tabs, and a transcript's views slide in from the side you picked and settle. On the Mac, a page rises or drops with the sidebar. Limit animation and Reduce Motion fade instead.
  • While your words are written, the Ribbon's bar keeps sweeping in every app.
  • A call you set up from the iPhone says Recording your call once the Mac starts.

Also on iPhone

  • Record as opens with a slight bounce, and the row under your finger lifts.
  • Transcribing again after a free continuation keeps the words from before it.
